newsitem.title: UK: DDB Needham joins forces with ad agency in Tunisia.
newsitem.headline: DDB Needham joins forces with ad agency in Tunisia.

text.p: DDB International, a part of U.S.-based DDB Needham advertising agency network, said on Monday it had established presence in Tunisia by joining forces with a local partner.
It said in a statement it had linked up with Ceres Conseil, which it described as the leading communications group in Tunisia, with an ad agency and printing and publication divisions.

DDB said Ceres Conseil had total billings of $5.0 million, including $2.0 million for its ad agency, and served international clients such as Whirlpool, Mitsubishi and Henkel, as well as local clients.
DDB, which is part of the U.S.-based holding company, Omnicom Group Inc, said the link with Ceres Conseil represented an important expansion of its presence in Africa.
"The addition of Tunisia to DDB's Middle East/African Network signals DDB's presence in 14 countries in the area," Bernard Brochand, president of DDB International, said.
"The network's coverage is now equal to the biggest in the region -- a significant achievement considering we initiated development in this region four years ago," he said.
DDB Needham is the fifth largest advertising network in the world, with 245 offices in 86 countries.
